definitions: To drain or draw off (liquid) by means of a siphon.
To illegally or unfairly draw off or transfer funds, resources, or profits, especially in a gradual or secretive manner.
examples: They used a tube to siphon off the gasoline from the tank.
The corrupt official managed to siphon off millions from public funds.
He tried to siphon off some of the company's profits into his personal account.
